content: AGENTS.md sits exactly at its frozen check:prose ceiling (92 violations), so any new bullet must add zero violations. The sentence counter splits per wrapped line and also splits on colon+space before a quote, so inline YAML/TS shape snippets like { method: 'x' } count as extra sentences and can push a bullet over long-paragraph(>6s). Describe the shape in prose instead and keep the literal in docs/design/warren-config.md. Each em-dash costs one dash violation. Verify with: bun run scripts/check-prose.ts --report | grep AGENTS
